- When sentiment is high (≥0.6), model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast by 1–3% for next period.
- After a price spike (forecast > 70), model often overshoots; cap forecast at +5% above peak or use moving average of prior 5 days.
- If sentiment is low (≤0.4) and price is falling, model underestimates; add 1–2% to forecast to avoid premature bottoming.
- Model consistently underestimates late-period (last 5–7 days) prices; apply 2–4% upward bias for final 5–7 days of forecast.
- When sentiment is volatile (rapid swings), model reacts too slowly; adjust forecast to match sentiment direction within 1–2 days lag.
- Mean reversion bias: if price is above 70 for 3+ consecutive days, model tends to overcorrect; apply downward bias of 1–3% for next 3 days.
